_note: An areal family of two culture-areas: Plains horse-nomads (Numinan, drawing on Comanche/Apache/Cheyenne) and Eastern Woodland longhouse-confederacy (Oronan, drawing on the Iroquois/Haudenosaunee). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Plains and Iroquois registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon, never real gods. The two sub-palettes are unrelated tongues, so the two theonym sets are independent. No intra-family blend (both members are clean). Worship vs demonization is alignment-driven per culture (worship_by_alignment). ASCII orthography (ʉ->u; glottal stops kept).

phonology.palette: Two distinct registers from real source languages.

sub_palette_notes.plains: Plains (Comanche-leaning, with Apache and Cheyenne): Comanche roots (paa water, toya mountain, huupi tree, soni grass, taabe sun, mua moon, puuku horse, numu people), -pu/-bo endings, vowel u (written for the barred-u); Apache nantan (chief); pan-Plains akicita (warrior-society); descriptive deed-names rendered in the usual way (Ten Bears, Iron Shirt).
sub_palette_notes.woodland: Woodland (Iroquois/Haudenosaunee): Mohawk-Iroquoian register, which genuinely lacks labials (no p/b/m/f); roots kanata (town), kanonhsa (longhouse), ononta (hill), kahyonha (river), kaniatare (lake), ohwachira (matrilineal family); titles royaner/hoyaneh (sachem), rotiskenrakehte (war chief), tadodaho (presiding firekeeper); the clan-mothers (Iakoia:ner) hold the titles.

phonology.phonotactics: Plains: CV(C), glottal stops, the barred-u vowel. Woodland: CV(C), NO labials, glottal stops, long polysynthetic compounds.

lexicon_concepts._note: Same concept inventory as the other family bases; realized in the real register per sub-palette (the two are unrelated and share nothing).

shared_roots._note: Areal grouping only; the two registers are unrelated languages. Parallels are at the culture-CONCEPT level.
shared_roots.social-unit: Plains: band/division (Comanche e.g. Kwahada, Penateka) | Woodland: ohwachira (matrilineal clan)
shared_roots.leadership: Plains: paraibo (peace-chief), tekwuniwap (war chief), nantan (Apache chief) | Woodland: royaner/hoyaneh (sachem), chosen and deposed by the clan-mothers
shared_roots.council: Plains: the chiefs' council and warrior-societies | Woodland: the Grand Council of the Haudenosaunee under the Tadodaho

theonym_sets._note: TWO INDEPENDENT sets (unrelated tongues); morphs of the Agrippan canon, never real Plains/Woodland gods. plains (used by Numinan and the Plains side of Karakan); woodland (used by Oronan and the Woodland side of Senecar and Tikan; labial-free, matching real Iroquoian phonology). Same shared pantheon; different names. Worship vs demonization assigned at runtime by each culture's CURRENT alignment.

morphology_template.toponymic_suffixes: Plains: feature + Comanche root (toya- mtn, paa- water, soni- grass). Woodland: kanata- (town), -ononta (hill), kahyonha- (river), karhakon- (forest).
morphology_template.patronymic_form: Plains: band/division (Comanche) + an earned deed/vision-name. Woodland: ohwachira (matrilineal clan, by animal-totem) + a clan-held name bestowed by the clan-mother.
morphology_template.gendered_endings: Plains: descriptive (deed-names), Comanche -pu/-bo for some. Woodland: m ra-/ro-/-ronon, f ka-/io-/-wenne.
morphology_template.compounding_rule: Plains [quality|animal] + feature (descriptive deed/place names). Woodland long compounds [quality|feature] + place (Onekwenhtara-karhakon, red-forest).

title_ladder_structure._note: ACKS 7 tiers, both members clanhold. Plains: chiefs-by-deed (paraibo/nantan), war chiefs (tekwuniwap), warrior-societies (akicita), a head-chief over a confederation. Woodland: sachems (royaner/hoyaneh) chosen and deposed by the clan-mothers, the Grand Council under the Tadodaho (presiding firekeeper); the Confederacy has no monarch - the tiers map ACKS levels onto the real council hierarchy. Tier->ruler-level mapping pending the ACKS lookup.

conventions.people_name_default: Plains: an earned deed/vision-name + band/division. Woodland: a clan-held name (or hereditary sachem title-name) + ohwachira (matrilineal clan).
